html:
Split text on whitespace and return a dictionary mapping each case-sensitive word to its occurrence count. Punctuation stays attached to a word.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "tea tea coffee"
  ],
  "expected": {
    "tea": 2,
    "coffee": 1
  }
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    ""
  ],
  "expected": {}
}
Hint

Use words as keys.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(n) space in the worst case
